title: HELIX Bridge (Reverse): HELIX Person → Banner SaaS (Ethos)
write_model: POST /api/persons to create (returns a new GUID) or PUT /api/persons/{guid} to update. Idempotency via external crosswalk keyed on Banner ID credential; search before create. Names, emails, phones are embedded arrays; addresses and validation values (race, ethnicity, gender identity) are GUID references.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Do NOT write helix_id into Ethos. Maintain an external crosswalk (helix_id <-> Ethos person GUID). On create, capture the returned GUID and store it.
attribute_mappings.notes: Ethos identity is the GUID; helix_id stays in the HELIX crosswalk table.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map the visible Banner ID into the credentials array with credentialType 'Banner ID'.
attribute_mappings.notes: Ethos 'persons' exposes credentials[] for Banner ID, Colleague Person ID, SSN, ELV, etc.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to the legal name entry (names[].type.category='legal').
attribute_mappings.notes: Ethos persons.names[] is typed (legal, birth, preferred, ...).
FLAG: Ethos field name for prefix is 'title' in most persons schema versions — verify against tenant API version.
FLAG: suffix commonly maps to 'pedigree' in Ethos persons; verify per API version.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Write a second names[] entry with type.category='preferred'.
Map helix gender to Ethos gender enum (male/female/unknown).
Map helix/gender-identity to the tenant's gender-identities GUID.
attribute_mappings.notes: FLAG: genderIdentity is a GUID reference to the gender-identities resource; requires lookup.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map each helix/ethnicity code to a races[] GUID; Hispanic/Latino maps to persons.ethnicity (guid ref to ethnicities).
attribute_mappings.notes: Races and ethnicity are GUID-referenced validation resources.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map address + type (institutional->school, personal->personal, work->work). Set preferred flag.
Map number + type (mobile/home/work) + countryCallingCode. Set preferred.
Address is a separate Ethos 'addresses' resource; person references it. Create/resolve address GUID, then link with type + effective dates.
attribute_mappings.notes: FLAG: in newer Ethos models addresses are a standalone resource referenced by GUID rather than embedded.

constraints: persons is one of the few Ethos resources that supports direct create/update (POST/PUT). Most other operational records require business-process APIs.
SSN and other sensitive credentials require appropriate Ethos application scopes; may be restricted by tenant policy.
Duplicate prevention: search persons by credentials (Banner ID) or matchingRequests before POST to avoid creating duplicate GUIDs.
Race/ethnicity/gender-identity are GUID-referenced validation resources — resolve GUIDs from the tenant before writing.
